model_description: DINOv2-large backbone (Apache 2.0) with a segmentation head, fine-tuned on 175 hand-labelled 250 m squares in Laredo
imagery: USDA NAIP 2022, 0.6 m, 4-band (via Microsoft Planetary Computer)
validation_set: 150 stratified random 250 m squares in Laredo, hand-labelled blind (225 ha of surface parking); not used to choose the rules' thresholds beyond the precision-first package

calibration.method: Combined ratio estimator over 6 land-use strata (label area / mapped area on the random squares) times the mapped citywide total

notes: Precision first: 19 of 20 mapped square metres are surface parking; the map deliberately misses about 30% of parking (small lots, apartment parking, lots under trees).
Surface type (paved vs gravel) is not distinguished: models could not learn it from 0.6 m imagery.
Exempt status is not available for Laredo (the parcel file omits exempt parcels), so lots on school, church and government land show as taxable or unmatched.
